A1.justification: Both PDFs describe PASDiff and have readable main text, equations, tables, and figures. V1 includes supplementary material on pages 19–30; v2 instead links a separate, unsupplied supplement. Its contents cannot be assumed retained, changed, or deleted.

before.justification: V1 reports original benchmark evaluations, face-recognition results, component ablations, a user study, and supplementary robustness and efficiency experiments.

after.justification: V2 retains original benchmark evaluations, face-recognition results, component ablations, and user-study findings in its main text.

M1.justification: The diffusion procedure, photometric losses, and SASI/AdaIN mechanism remain unchanged. Algorithm 1 is identical to v1's supplementary pseudocode. The revised exposure hyperparameters are experimental-setting changes, not a new method component.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same joint enhancement/restoration task using 1,000 synthetic FFHQ images and 700 WildDark-Face images. Replacement qualitative examples do not establish new dataset or scenario coverage.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain the same four cascaded and six joint-restoration comparators, and Fig. 4 retains the same user-study comparators. However, v1's separate efficiency comparison against LightenDiffusion→TSD-SR and LightenDiffusion→DiffBIR cannot be checked against v2's unavailable supplement.

E3.justification: Section 3.2 changes the exposure-map parameters from alpha=0.55 and beta=0.15 to alpha=0.46 and beta=0.25. This explicitly revises reported inference settings without establishing reruns. Main benchmark sizes, degradation settings, metrics, and the ten diffusion timesteps remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The main component ablations remain unchanged. V1 additionally tests exposure/structural-weight sensitivity, an accelerated N=2 configuration, and dataset degradation distributions, with further visual ablations. Their status in v2 cannot be established without its separately linked supplement.

E5.justification: V1's supplement specifies ten evaluators, 200 ratings per perceptual dimension, and mean-ranking-score aggregation. V2 retains the user-study summary but does not include the corresponding detailed statistical documentation. Neither accessible main text adds confidence intervals, significance tests, or seed reporting.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–5 are unchanged, including PASDiff's 22.59 PSNR and 71.43% recognition accuracy. Figs. 1 and 6 replace real-image examples. The overall extent of result changes remains uncertain because v1's supplementary results, including Table S1's 4.92-second accelerated configuration, lack an accessible v2 counterpart.

T1.justification: Equations 1–13 retain their mathematical form, and no theorem, proof, or substantive derivation changes are identified. V1's supplementary mean-ranking formula merely explains an empirical metric; relocating Algorithm 1 adds no theory.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about training-free joint restoration, physics-aware guidance, SASI, the 700-image benchmark, and superior restoration quality.

C2.justification: Main-text mechanism explanations and limitations concerning inference speed and extreme-darkness color recovery remain unchanged. V1's supplementary interpretations of hyperparameter robustness, speed–quality flexibility, and detectability versus recognizability cannot be compared with the unavailable later supplement.

D1.justification: V2 adds a planned code/dataset repository link and revises the exposure parameters; its pseudocode was already available in v1. However, retention or revision of v1's detailed dataset construction, timing setup, and blinded user-study protocol cannot be assessed without v2's supplement.

R1.justification: V2 adds citations to DLFN, measurement-constrained sampling, and Seeing Through the Rain, while removing the multiscale Retinex and progressive face-super-resolution references. These are limited literature updates; the central positioning remains unchanged, and the added works are not new evaluated baselines.

P1.justification: The supplied document substantially reorganizes supporting material: v1's embedded supplementary sections are replaced by external links, while Algorithm 1 moves into the methodology. Main-text edits are otherwise limited to copyediting, expanded affiliations, cross-references, and acknowledgements.

P2.justification: V1's supplementary plots, ablation/comparison galleries, and Table S1 are no longer embedded in the supplied v2. Within the main text, Fig. 1 adds ground truth and replaces its real example, Fig. 2 adds highlighted regions, Fig. 4 is restyled, and Fig. 6 replaces examples.

improvement.justification: V2 offers clearer figure annotations, accessible main-text pseudocode, and a planned resource link, while retaining all main numerical results. The unexplained exposure-parameter revision does not demonstrate better performance. Because the later supplement is unavailable, retention of important robustness, efficiency, and reproducibility evidence cannot be assessed, preventing a reliable overall quality judgment.
